root_cause: drc_auto.py carries a hardcoded shebang '#!/apps/local/bin/python3' that launches a system interpreter, while .bashrc runs 'module switch python/3.11.9' and exports PYTHONHOME, PYTHONPATH, LD_LIBRARY_PATH for the module-managed Python. The hardcoded interpreter is thus executed under a mismatched Python environment and cannot find its own standard library, aborting with 'initfsencoding: unable to load the file system codec / ModuleNotFoundError: No module named encodings'.
fix_summary: Rewrote the shebang from '#!/apps/local/bin/python3' to '#!/usr/bin/env python3' so the launcher resolves python3 via PATH (the module-selected Python 3.11.9) and inherits a consistent PYTHONHOME/PYTHONPATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH. All other file content was preserved.
